Introduction to the Project

This document provides an introduction to the FAQ Generator project. The FAQ Generator
is a command-line tool that processes a folder of documents and generates a comprehensive
FAQ in Markdown format.

The tool supports PDF, DOCX, and TXT files. It uses the Anthropic Claude API to analyze
document content and extract relevant question-answer pairs. The generated FAQ is saved
to output/faq.md.

Key features include automatic document discovery, intelligent text chunking with
sentence-boundary awareness, semantic deduplication of questions, and progress reporting
during processing.
